name: Human

traits.name: Quick Study
traits.description: +10% to every XP gain: skill ranks, attribute points, item levels, field skills and the pet's 50% share. Multiplies after Wisdom's +1% per point.

traits.name: Adaptable
traits.description: One extra loadout preset (a saved 4 + 2 + stance set swappable in town and rest rooms; default 2, Humans 3) and +1 starting rank in all eight field skills (rank 2 at creation).

creationBlurb: Emberfall's own. Learns everything a little faster and has no weak spot.
